rootCauses.cause: FreeNet Hub open_browser proxied TOR but not NODE, even though NODE sing-box exposes SOCKS on 127.0.0.1:19460.
rootCauses.prevention: Mode-to-proxy-port mapping, NODE pre-launch tunneled trace, session proxyPort recording, browser profile regression, and exact package CI.

rootCauses.cause: Ubuntu 24.04 to 26.04.1 release upgrade left the pre-reboot graphical session inconsistent; GDM/Firefox launch failures were resolved by the required owner-controlled reboot.
rootCauses.prevention: Do not retain a product Firefox workaround after a release upgrade until post-reboot standard Firefox is retested.

rejectedWorkaround.reason: Snap Firefox 157 launched successfully after the required Ubuntu 26 reboot; standard Ubuntu/Snap Firefox is sufficient.

nodePoolRefresh.note: TCP endpoint reachability was not treated as proxy-health acceptance.

transientFailurePrevention.observation: One existing healthy NODE produced a transient first TRACE_FAILED while subsequent SOCKS trace immediately passed.
transientFailurePrevention.guard: _node_verify_stable performs at most two bounded verification attempts with 0.5 second delay.

authority.releaseAssetPlan: Add Linux R18 asset to existing latest v4.3.7 release after exact-SHA hosted CI passes.

openGate: Hosted CI on exact candidate commit, then upload/verify Linux R18 release asset and post-publish updater behavior.
